label: Bible Study
prompt: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his _____ to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verse: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
note: God's sunshine doesn't check credentials — Jesus' reason for loving even enemies.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the _____ of salvation.
verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
note: Drawing water with joy from the wells of salvation — a bucket that never comes up empty.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them _____, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verse: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
note: Heaven's elders come with harps and golden vials full of odours — which turn out to be the prayers of saints.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For he knoweth our _____; he remembereth that we are dust.
verse: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
note: God remembers we're made of dust, so his compassion is tailored to our real limits.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let all things be done _____ and in order.
verse: Let all things be done decently and in order.
note: Paul's closing rule for Corinth's chaotic worship services: 'decently and in order.' Church business meetings agree.
